note: Written after directory.json was frozen (sha256 be0874030f0c95dd6083fd3d1e8fdfae4fa956ff848c7b67d4c25c1053e5dea7) and before any model call. `acceptable` lists every alias set that answers the question correctly; [] means load nothing. A question with one acceptable set scores `exact` on a match; one with several scores `acceptable` on any match. Labels do not change after this file's hash is reported.

questions.text: How many building permits did Chicago issue in 2025?
What were the most common restaurant inspection violations in New York City last year?
How many car break-ins were reported in San Francisco in the past six months?
Which Seattle neighborhoods had the most code compliance complaints this year?
How many noise complaints did New York City 311 receive last month?
questions.note: Counting complaints needs the 311 dataset on NYC Open Data; nyc_311 only looks up requests by number (its tools: get_calendar, get_status, get_service_request, get_service_request_list).

questions.text: What was average weekday subway ridership in New York in 2025?
questions.note: MTA ridership is published on data.ny.gov, a Socrata portal; nyc_mta covers alerts, outages and station lookup only.
